title: [YouPass Collect] - Student Accommodation Changes Over Time
prompt: The two plans below show student accommodation in 2010 and now. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.​

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The two floor plans illustrate the layout of a student accommodation building in 2010 and how it appears today.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the accommodation has undergone significant redevelopment to increase its capacity, with the most notable change being the removal of the living room to make way for additional student bedrooms. Furthermore, a car parking area has been added, while the surrounding gardens have been substantially reduced in size.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: In terms of internal modifications, the living room, which was located in the western section of the building in 2010, has been completely removed and replaced by a student bedroom. Additionally, the kitchen, formerly positioned in the centre of the accommodation, has been relocated to the eastern side and expanded into a combined kitchen and social area. With regard to bathroom facilities, while the original bathroom in the western part remains, an en-suite bathroom has been added adjacent to the kitchen/social area.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Concerning external changes and overall capacity, the gardens that previously surrounded the building on three sides have been significantly reduced, with only the garden on the western side remaining. The space at the southern end of the property has been converted into a car parking area. Most notably, the total number of student bedrooms has increased from three to five, with new bedrooms added in the northern section where gardens previously existed.
